name: Basic Business Knowledge Scale (BBKS)
product_description: The BBKS is an 18-item self-report questionnaire developed by Bernal-Guerrero, Cárdenas-Gutiérrez, and Montoro-Fernández to measure compulsory-secondary students’ basic business knowledge in management, legal, and strategic domains.
